messages:
emma (Customer): Hey team — user on iPhone 14 (carrier: MacroTel) reported SSE stream abruptly closing mid-response while commuting. No error returned to client, app saw partial JSON then connection close. Happened 2026-03-16T08:12:03Z. session_id=hs7f3-cck9

maya (Support): Thanks. Can you DM the session_id + request id? Any repro steps?

emma (Customer): Pushed session_id. Repro steps: start chat, stay in streaming mode, walk from underground level to bus, around cell tower handover point (~2s window) user sees silence then socket close. Happens ~2/10 attempts.

maya (Support): Escalating to Eng-oncall; attaching last 30s of server logs for trace id we got.


dan (Eng-Oncall): Looking. Trace hs7f3-cck9 shows normal token acceptance, then TCP FIN from client at tcp_seq 12543, no RST. Server still streaming data after last send for ~350ms. No app-level error logged. Can you paste client logs (socket state) around close?

emma (Customer): Client logs attached: "SSE: received: \"data: {\"text\": \"...partial...\"}\n\" then socket.onclose (code=1006) with no payload". Also: network change event: "carrier changed: macrocell->smallcell"


li (Mobile Eng): Mobile OS note: during LTE/5G inter-RAT handover the modem can silently tear down user TCP while re-establishing RRC. If the app's TCP keepalive is too long, the socket can close with no HTTP-level close. Do we have keepalive/ping frequency on SSE client?


oliver (QA): Repro candidate: emulate handover with a TB (testbed) moving between cells + limited packet loss. Could try lowering keepalive interval or sending SSE comment pings `: ping\n\n` every 10s.


dan (Eng-Oncall): Server side shows last chunk sent included final bytes of a JSON object but not trailing newline terminator; client may treat as incomplete. Also load-balancer logs show connection flagged as "idle" at the same time window and lb sent FIN to backend after TCP inactivity 30s — but stream was active, so suspicious.


maya (Support): So two possible contributors: carrier handover causing client-side TCP close, and load-balancer idle detection closing mid-chunk. What's a concrete mitigation?


dan (Eng-Oncall): Short-term: advise clients to enable application-level keepalive (SSE comment ping) every 10s and use Last-Event-ID resume to avoid duplicate content. Server-side: we'll increase edge idle timeout for streaming connections from 30s -> 75s for this customer segment to avoid lb-induced mid-chunk closes.


li (Mobile Eng): Also recommend client listen for `navigator.connection` change events and on network-type change attempt graceful reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`. On iOS, background handovers are flaky; consider bumping the socket-level keepalive (OS-level) if possible.


oliver (QA): I'll create a small repro harness: script to toggle interface between good/poor and trigger handover, capture pcap, and reproduce missing newline termination. Will also run with comment pings at 5s/10s/20s to measure success rate.


deploy-bot: Rolling config patch to edge pool streaming-timeout applied to canary (2 nodes). See: https://console.redwood/api/deploys/9887 :ok_hand:


dan (Eng-Oncall): Action items: 1) increase edge idle timeout for affected region (in progress), 2) QA reproduce and capture pcap (oliver), 3) send client guidance (maya -> emma) about keepalive/ping + resume, 4) product to consider explicit "stream-chunk-ack" if we keep seeing truncated JSON.


maya (Support): Emma — forwarding client guidance now with sample client code: \n```\n// SSE client: send comment ping every 10s\nconst es = new EventSource(url);\nsetInterval(() => { fetch('/sse/ping?sid='+sessionId); }, 10000);\n// Use Last-Event-ID header on reconnect\n```

emma (Customer): Thanks. I'll push a quick client-side ping and report back tomorrow after commute window. Appreciate the canary change.


dan (Eng-Oncall): Marking P2 until repro rate confirmed. If QA reproduces reliably we'll schedule deeper LB and kernel-socket trace.


oliver (QA): If anyone needs the TB for reproduction ping me — I'll start lab run today and paste pcap + sample metrics here.


maya (Support): Closing loop for now — tracking in support ticket #RD-7241. Will update when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
